subject: Confirming prohibition on model tuning & log retention — NovusTech pilot
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Joe Martin <joe.martin@novustech.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-09T15:12:00Z
Subject: Recap: data handling requirements from today's discovery call

Hi Joe — great speaking with you earlier. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery: 

- You want Redwood to run the NovusTech pilot in our hosted environment but with strict data controls (no customer data used to tune or improve any models, and logs retained only for debugging for a short window).
- Key asks: absolute prohibition on model tuning, 30-day log retention with optional redaction, and US-only residency for any persisted telemetry.

Can you confirm those three points are accurate? If yes, we'll produce a short attestation and a one-page statement that can be added to the MPA.

I copied Neha (info-security) to answer the technical/logging bit and Ben for contractual next steps.

Next steps: 
1) You confirm wording for the no-tuning clause OR share suggested language by EOD Wednesday.
2) We (Neha + Marissa) will draft the data handling statement and route for signature.
3) Ben will attach the standard MPA redline with a custom clause for the pilot.

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0179
Redwood Inference
From: Joe Martin <joe.martin@novustech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Anika Roy <anika.roy@novustech.com>
Date: 2027-08-09T18:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Recap: data handling requirements from today's discovery call

Marissa — thanks for the recap and the quick follow. Confirming the three bullets as written:

1) No customer data used to tune, train, or benchmark Redwood models — period.
2) Logs retained only for incident debug and performance troubleshooting, 30 days maximum. Must be able to request deletion earlier.
3) Data and logs must remain in the US (we have strictly US-based tenants for pilot).

Also two clarifying points: 
- Are we able to get a machine-readable statement we can upload to our privacy portal?
- For the deletion request, who is the contact; we need a process map (SLA for deletion acknowledgement).

If those are included, we can sign and move forward — want to kick off next week.

Joe
VP Product, NovusTech
joe.martin@novustech.com
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Joe Martin <joe.martin@novustech.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-10T09:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Recap: data handling requirements from today's discovery call

Thanks, Joe — glad we're aligned. A few clarifications from the security side: 

- "No model tuning" will be reflected in the pilot attestation as: "Redwood Inference will not use NovusTech customer data to train, fine-tune, or improve any models at any stage of the pilot. Data used for inference will not be retained beyond the retention window described below except where required by law."

- Log retention: default 30 days. We will implement an expedited deletion process on request; deletion requests will be acknowledged within 48 hours and fully completed within 10 business days (we will provide a deletion receipt).

- Residency: all persisted telemetry and logs for this pilot will be stored in US-region buckets (no cross-region replication).

Attachments: I attached a draft one-page data handling statement and a suggested SLAs table for deletion acknowledgment (filenames below). Ben, please add the pilot clause to the MPA and share the redline.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Director, InfoSec — Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: novustech-data-handling-stmt.pdf (draft), deletion-sla-table.csv (internal)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Joe Martin <joe.martin@novustech.com>, Anika Roy <anika.roy@novustech.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-11T09:04:00Z
Subject: Final: Prohibition on model tuning confirmed + signature path

Joe / Anika — per Neha's wording above, NovusTech's requirements are confirmed. Attached is the final one-page data handling statement and the MPA redline including the pilot prohibition clause. Once you approve the one-pager we will route the MPA for signature via DocuSign.

For machine-readable upload: we will provide both a PDF and a JSON attestation file (example attached as novustech-data-handling-stmt.pdf and signed-mpa-novustech.pdf; JSON attestation will be posted to the HubSpot record link below).

Deletion contact & SLA:
- Deletion requests should go to privacy-ops@redwoodinference.com (acknowledge within 48 hours, complete within 10 business days).

Ben will start contract routing and will follow up on pricing adjustments for the reserved pilot seats.

If you reply with "Approved" on the one-pager, we'll send the DocuSign envelope and the JSON attestation.

Best,
Marissa
--
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
